description: The opensparrow root contains a usable Longrun + Spec-Kit persistence workflow and a dedicated unified workspace.
acceptance_criteria: `AGENTS.md`, `.specify/`, `.codex/`, `docs/`, `longrun/`, and `scripts/codex` exist in the repo root.
`longrun/workspaces/opensparrow-unified/` exists with app spec, feature list, progress log, and init script.
`docs/项目持久化说明.md` points future sessions to the unified workspace.
steps: Import the persistence skeleton into the root.
Create a unified workspace for continued execution.
Update persistence docs to point at the new workspace.
evidence_hint: Root tree + unified workspace files + docs updated

description: openclawNative source-of-truth assets are imported into canonical `vendor/` and `platforms/*/companion/` directories and its legacy workspace is adapted.
acceptance_criteria: `vendor/{linux-openclaw,mac-openclaw,windows-openclaw}/` exist in the root.
`platforms/{linux,mac,windows}/companion/` contain the migrated source files.
`longrun/workspaces/openclaw-native/` points to the new root paths.
steps: Copy vendor bundles into `vendor/`.
Copy companion source files into `platforms/*/companion/`.
Adapt the imported openclaw-native workspace metadata and init script.

description: The OpenSparrow USB/Feishu source-of-truth assets are imported into the root and the portable legacy workspace remains usable.
acceptance_criteria: `specs/002-*` through `specs/005-*`, `scripts/openclaw-usb/`, `skills/`, `research/`, `ui/`, and `docs/runbooks/` exist in the root.
`longrun/workspaces/openclaw-usb-portable/` exists in the root with its execution docs preserved.
The portable workspace metadata no longer points to the old root as the active repo root.
steps: Copy portable source-of-truth assets from `feishu-source/`.
Copy UI, runbooks, and docs from `usb-pack/` source directories.
Update portable workspace metadata to the new root.

description: A merged multi-platform unification scheme based on the latest Claude/Codex research is recorded in docs, spec, and longrun.
acceptance_criteria: A root-level solution document exists under `docs/`.
`specs/006-opensparrow-root-unification/` contains `spec.md`, `plan.md`, and `tasks.md`.
The unified workspace progress log references the chosen approach and next steps.
steps: Summarize the merged risk conclusions and execution method.
Write the new feature spec, plan, and tasks.
Record the current execution status in longrun.

description: The root repo is bootstrapped with `.gitattributes`, `.gitignore`, and root guidance to support a clean first Git history.
acceptance_criteria: `.gitattributes` exists in the root with LF/CRLF/binary rules.
`.gitignore` exists in the root and freezes legacy directories and generated outputs.
`AGENTS.md` and `.specify/memory/constitution.md` reflect the new root structure.
steps: Write root line-ending and ignore policies.
Write merged agent and constitution guidance.
Initialize git in the root.

description: The unified workspace, imported legacy workspaces, and shell entrypoints all validate under the new root layout.
acceptance_criteria: `./longrun/workspaces/opensparrow-unified/init.sh` succeeds.
Imported legacy workspace init scripts succeed or clearly report only expected optional warnings.
Touched shell and `.command` scripts pass `bash -n`.
steps: Run unified workspace init.
Run legacy workspace init scripts.
Run shell syntax checks and record evidence.

description: After the root unification stabilizes, the repo completes logical legacy archive freeze and lands the first Docker baseline under `deploy/docker/`.
acceptance_criteria: `docs/legacy-archive-freeze-20260323.md` and `scripts/verify-legacy-freeze.sh` define and validate the frozen legacy boundary.
`deploy/docker/` contains Docker baseline assets, including `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`, `.env.example`, and helper scripts.
Compose/bootstrap/status flow is documented and at least the config + `/api/status` path is runnable.
Legacy native delivery paths remain explicitly preserved in docs and runbooks.
steps: Freeze legacy directories as logical archive and add verification.
Implement Docker baseline assets and shared runtime entrypoints.
Validate container status flow and sync longrun/docs.
evidence_hint: Archive docs + verify script + Docker assets + status validation
